# test_gcd.py
import pytest

from your_module import gcd  # replace "your_module" with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        (54, 24, 6),
        (24, 54, 6),
        (17, 13, 1),
        (270, 192, 6),
        (100, 10, 10),
        (7, 7, 7),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_happy_path(a, b, expected):
    assert gcd(a, b) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        (0, 5, 5),
        (5, 0, 5),
        (0, 0, 0),
        (-54, 24, 6),
        (54, -24, 6),
        (-54, -24, 6),
        (-7, 0, 7),
        (0, -7, 7),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_edge_cases(a, b, expected):
    assert gcd(a, b) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b"),
    [
        ("54", 24),
        (54, "24"),
        ([54], 24),
        (54, [24]),
        (None, 1),
    ],
)
def test_gcd_invalid_types_raise_type_error(a, b):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        gcd(a, b)


def test_gcd_result_is_always_non_negative():
    assert gcd(-12, -18) >= 0
    assert gcd(-12, 18) >= 0
    assert gcd(12, -18) >= 0
